finding_1.title: CreateProcessAsUserW cross-session stdio handle inheritance
finding_1.evidence: Frozen service captures actual pipe-client primary token via DuplicateTokenEx, service lines 1723-1800; passes token and inherited stdio handles to backend at service lines 3038-3043. Context backend captured after freeze sets inherit_handles=True when stdio list exists, backend lines 840-875, then calls CreateProcessAsUserW with that flag, lines 904-919.
finding_1.trigger: Typical SCM service caller is Session 0; interactive owner client token retains nonzero TokenSessionId. CreateProcessAsUserW creates worker in the client token session. The implementation neither reads nor changes token session and requires inherited handles for stdout/NUL.
finding_1.source: Microsoft Learn CreateProcessAsUserW API: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessasuserw — Terminal Services note says handles cannot be inherited across sessions and bInheritHandles=TRUE requires same session as caller.
finding_1.minimal_fix: Use a bounded named-pipe output channel opened by the worker with no cross-session inherited handles, or fail closed on a verified session mismatch. Do not mutate TokenSessionId without a separately reviewed privilege and identity contract.
finding_1.test_gap: Fake composition does not model Session 0 versus interactive TokenSessionId nor actual cross-session CreateProcessAsUserW handle behavior.

finding_2.title: RevertToSelf failure is swallowed before privileged follow-up
finding_2.evidence: Token capture raises pipe_client_revert_failed when RevertToSelf fails, service lines 1805-1814. _serve_one_readonly_os_request catches it broadly and continues, lines 3102-3110, then calls close_execution and create_receipt and attempts response, lines 3128-3198, on that same thread.
finding_2.trigger: If RevertToSelf fails, the thread may remain impersonating the client. Current handler performs anchor/receipt/response work and returns control to the service caller with that thread identity still changed.
finding_2.minimal_fix: Terminate the service process immediately on RevertToSelf failure; do not merely retire a thread and do not run receipt/response/other privileged follow-up on that process. Add an integration negative proving no follow-up after failure.
finding_2.test_gap: Low-level unit test only asserts pipe_client_revert_failed; no handler test proves thread retirement or follow-up is skipped.
